overall_notes: The paper presents DocLens, a comprehensive medical text evaluation framework. The extraction was generally accurate but contained duplicates and inconsistent formatting. Major changes include normalizing metric/task names, consolidating BART model variations, and clarifying human evaluation guidelines. The paper strongly fits all four categories with extensive NLG evaluation using both automatic metrics and LLM/human judges.
